meta.title: Eligibility Questionnaire — EZRA MAROC
meta.intro: Your in-depth eligibility questionnaire, in complete confidentiality.
meta.privacy: Your data is processed in strict confidence, in accordance with the GDPR, and is never shared without your explicit consent. To exercise your rights: info@ezra-project.fr.

ui.errEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
ui.errTel: Please enter a valid phone number (with country code).
ui.successText: Thank you, we have received your answers. They will be reviewed with the utmost care.
ui.errorText: An error occurred. You can try again; if the problem persists, please write to us at info@ezra-project.fr.
ui.expiredText: This access is no longer valid. Please contact your EZRA MAROC advisor to obtain a new one.
ui.consentBlock: Without your consent, we are unable to process your request.
ui.accessText: To open your questionnaire, enter the password we sent you in a separate email.
ui.errCodeFormat: The password consists of 8 characters (letters and numbers).
ui.errCodeWrong: Incorrect password. You have {n} attempt(s) remaining.
ui.lockedText: Too many incorrect passwords have been entered: for your security, this access has been blocked. Please contact your EZRA MAROC advisor to obtain a new one.
ui.usedText: This questionnaire has already been completed and submitted. Thank you! To change an answer, write to us at info@ezra-project.fr.
ui.errBot: The anti-bot check could not be completed. Please try again in a few seconds.
ui.errNetwork: Unable to connect. Please check your internet connection, then try again.
ui.sessionExpired: For your security, your session has expired. Please sign in again: your answers have been preserved.
ui.loginTitle: Sign in to your Client Area
ui.loginText: Enter the email address at which you received our messages and the password we sent you in a separate email.
ui.errLoginFormat: Please check the email address and the password (8 characters).
ui.errLogin: Incorrect email address or password. Use the address at which you received our messages.
ui.noAccess: No login details yet? Access to the Client Area is opened by our team after a first conversation.
ui.welcomeText: This questionnaire allows us to make a first assessment of your eligibility for Moroccan nationality. Please answer as accurately as possible: it is the basis of our analysis.
ui.step1Text: With your email address and the password you received in a separate email.
ui.step2Text: 5 short steps, about 10 minutes. You can go back to previous steps at any time.
ui.step3Text: Just once. Our team will get back to you within 72 business hours.
ui.trust2: Your answers are read only by the EZRA MAROC team
ui.trust3: Your answers are not kept on your device
ui.requiredNote: All questions are required unless marked (optional).
ui.reviewIntro: Check your answers before sending them: you can edit any step until you send.
ui.submitNote: Sending is final: you will no longer be able to change your answers online. For any later correction, email us at info@ezra-project.fr.
ui.next1: Our team carefully reviews your questionnaire.
ui.next2: We will contact you within 72 business hours.
ui.next3: We will have a first confidential conversation about the next steps.

questions.label: Moroccan ancestors
questions.text: Do you have any ancestors (parents, grandparents, great-grandparents) of Moroccan nationality?
questions.help: Under the Moroccan Nationality Code, nationality is passed on mainly by descent (jus sanguinis, or the right of blood).

questions.label: Relationship to the Moroccan ancestor
questions.text: Please specify your relationship to your Moroccan ancestor(s), including the degree of kinship.

questions.label: Ancestor's old Moroccan documents
questions.text: Do you have any old Moroccan identity documents relating to this ancestor, or could you obtain some?

options.text: Yes, I currently have some documents.
I don't have any at the moment, but I think I can obtain some.
I don't have any, and I don't know how to obtain them.
No, and I don't think I can obtain any.

questions.label: Types of documents available
questions.text: What types of documents could you provide?

options.text: The ancestor's Moroccan passport (old or new)
The ancestor's Moroccan national identity card (CIN)
Birth certificate extract stating Moroccan nationality
Moroccan family record book (livret de famille)
Official document showing residence in Morocco (permit, certificate of residence, etc.)
Notarial deed or administrative document attesting to a link with Morocco
Moroccan military or civil service documents
Extracts from national archives proving affiliation with Morocco
Witness statements or official certificates establishing descent and nationality
